scope: Standing former Allen/Metropolitan Theatre at 281 Donald Street in Winnipeg, including its 1919 upper façade, later street canopy and south service wing.

originalReview.notes: Supports the principal composition, seven tall window bays, swags, pilasters and stacked cornice of the standing theatre. Ground-floor retail and Allen blade lettering are historical details.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact Qualla historical drawing matches Manitoba Archives N9863, reproduced as City of Winnipeg plate 1. The underlying sketch was published on November 29, 1919. Modern share-alike Qualla views were excluded.
